scope: Primary-source review for sphere spectral inequalities, singular Liouville equations, symmetry, and certifiable numerical subproblems. Not an exhaustive literature review or proof audit.

problem_statuses.name: Sharp scalar mean-zero L4 interpolation constant on S2
problem_statuses.qualification: Optimal-constant research question, not a named conjecture explicitly quoted from an author.

problem_statuses.name: Sharp scalar mean-zero orthonormal-family Lieb-Thirring constant on S2
problem_statuses.qualification: Do not transfer a result for Dirac operators, n>=5, or the real line to S2.

problem_statuses.name: Supercritical nonexistence for multiple negative singular sources on S2
problem_statuses.qualification: Recent author confirmation is desirable; no exhaustive citation database was searched.

problem_statuses.name: Axial symmetry of spherical Onsager vortex mean-field equation
problem_statuses.qualification: Plane-reflection symmetry is weaker than axial symmetry. This is not the Doi-Onsager liquid crystal model or Euler energy conservation conjecture.

problem_statuses.name: Parameterized spherical spectral sum inequality Ip(m)<1
Benguria-Loss ovals conjecture
problem_statuses.qualification: 2025 explicitly open; 2026 one-dimensional gamma=1 LT claim may change this through the 2004 connection. Domain and endpoint implications were not fully audited.

sources.title: On a class of interpolation inequalities on the 2D sphere
supports: Mean-zero multiplicative interpolation framework
Distinguishing known bounds from sharp constants
Ip(m)<1 for p>1 and m>0
sources.limitations: Proof was not independently reproduced. Exact sharp scalar C_* not identified by this source.

sources.title: Lieb-Thirring inequalities on the sphere
supports: Historical scalar sphere inequality
N=1 connection with Ladyzhenskaya inequality
sources.limitations: Historical 9/(4*pi) upper bound superseded by S3.

sources.title: Lieb-Thirring constant on the sphere and on the torus
supports: 1/(2*pi)<=K_*<=3*pi/32 for the stated scalar mean-zero sphere setting
N=1 upper bound
sources.limitations: No claim that this search proves the bound is the latest result everywhere.

sources.title: Lieb-Thirring inequalities for the Dirac operator on spheres
supports: Recent related result explicitly advertises classical sphere bound improvements for n>=5
sources.limitations: Abstract-level scope check only; not a proof review or S2 sharp-constant result.

sources.title: The Sphere Covering Inequality and Its Applications
reviewed_content: Sphere covering and nodal-set proof overview
supports: Published solution of the S2 Chang-Yang problem
Nonlinear center-of-mass constraint
Geometric intermediate inequality as a reusable proof mechanism
sources.limitations: The report does not claim the project reproduces this proof. For Onsager parameters the later S6 statement is used.

sources.title: A singular Sphere Covering Inequality: uniqueness and symmetry of solutions to singular Liouville-type equations
supports: Exact Q3 hypotheses and interval
Exact Q4 equation and conjectural range
Distinction between axial and plane-reflection symmetry
sources.limitations: Explicit open status is historical; later searches found no full resolution but cannot establish absence of one.

sources.title: A Generalization of the Sphere Covering Inequality
supports: Follow-up result allowing a constant boundary gap
sources.limitations: Reviewed statements do not directly claim a complete resolution of Q3 or Q4.

sources.title: A positive answer to the generalized Chang-Yang conjecture on S^N
supports: Recent preprint claims the generalized conjecture for all integer N>=3 and alpha>=1/2
sources.limitations: Proof not read in full or independently verified; recorded as a proof claim, not a mature consensus assessment.

sources.title: An improved bound for the ground state of a Schrödinger operator on a loop
supports: 2025 open status of ovals
Explicit two-variable lower-bound problem
Numerical 0.8246 versus analytic 0.81 distinction
sources.limitations: 2025 open status cannot be assumed current after S10; no numerical result has been re-certified by this task.

sources.title: The sharp one-dimensional Lieb-Thirring inequality for the sum of eigenvalues
reviewed_content: v1: Abstract, Theorem 1, introduction and ovals connection, displayed dual kinetic inequality
v2: Abstract, authors, submission and revision metadata only
supports: Very recent preprint claims a solution of the one-dimensional gamma=1 Lieb-Thirring conjecture
v2 abstract additionally claims an extension to operator-valued potentials and improved higher-dimensional constants
sources.limitations: New preprint proof claims, not independent confirmation. The reviewed body is v1; v2 proof was not reviewed. Do not transfer the real-line or Euclidean higher-dimensional theorem to S2. Its full implication for the ovals formulation was not audited.

sources.title: Connection between the Lieb-Thirring conjecture for Schrödinger operators and an isoperimetric problem for ovals on the plane
supports: Original connection between the two-function kinetic problem and ovals
sources.limitations: The task did not independently establish the converse domain and endpoint conditions needed to combine this with S10.

targeted_search_queries: Bartolucci Gui Jevnikar open problem sphere nonexistence
singular Liouville non-degeneracy sphere negative sources
Benguria Loss Connection Lieb Thirring conjecture isoperimetric ovals 2004 pdf
exclusions: Secondary summaries and search snippets were used only to discover primary sources, not to assert current open status.
Publication crawl dates were not used as paper dates.
Doi-Onsager liquid crystal results and Euler Onsager energy-conservation results were not treated as results about Q4.
No actual solve, benchmark pass, new theorem, model-token saving or model-speedup is claimed.
